fields.summary: Add audit log for admin actions
fields.description:
Administrators need a tamper-evident audit log of all privileged actions (user creation, permission changes, data deletion). Required for SOC 2 compliance.

Requirements:
- Log actor, action, target, timestamp, IP address
- Read-only view in admin panel
- Export to CSV

comments.body: This is required for our SOC 2 Type II audit in Q1 next year.
